questions.stem_text:
What do anthropologists NOT need to know to determine when people entered the Americas
from Siberia?

options.A: When sled dogs were first domesticated
options.B: When eastern Siberia was first inhabited
options.C: When the Bering Strait was exposed and open for travel
options.D: The timeline of the Ice Age

questions.answer_explanation: Anthropologists do not need to know when sled dogs were first domesticated because this information is unrelated to the archaeological and genetic evidence necessary to establish the timeline and routes of human migration from Siberia to the Americas.

questions.stem_text: What did the Moche build at the heart of their urban center?

options.A: the Temple of the Feathered Serpent
options.B: an enormous walled-in precinct of elite residences
options.C: the Palace of the Painted Walls

questions.answer_explanation: The Pyramid of the Sun was a significant architectural achievement of the Moche civilization, serving as a central ceremonial and cultural hub within their urban center, reflecting their advanced societal organization and religious practices.

questions.stem_text:
The influence of the Tiwanaku was eclipsed by the _________ culture, to the north and
west.
questions.answer_explanation: The Toltec culture, known for its significant influence on Mesoamerica and its emergence in the post-Tiwanaku period, overshadowed the earlier achievements of the Tiwanaku civilization through its expansive trade networks and cultural innovations.

questions.stem_text:
In periods of great difficulty and stress, it appears that the Minoans __________ in order
to appease the gods.

options.A: stopped all forms of art and music
options.E: burnt their own houses to the ground

questions.answer_explanation: The Minoans engaged in the practice of sacrificing adults and occasionally children during times of crisis as a means to seek favor and appease their deities, reflecting the cultural and religious beliefs of their civilization.

questions.stem_text: The Chinese process of divining the future by examining fired animal bones is called:
questions.answer_explanation: Scapulimancy is the correct answer because it specifically refers to the ancient Chinese practice of divining the future by interpreting the cracks formed in animal shoulder blades after they were heated.
